description: A gray plastic bin with several clear ice cubes sits on the table, with a small yellow cup to the left and a purple scoop on the right. The right hand picks up the purple scoop, dips it into the bin, and lifts out a load of ice while the left hand steadies and slightly tilts the bin; then the left hand grabs the yellow cup and holds it up as the right hand tilts the scoop to dump the ice cubes into the cup, making the cup the left-hand object and the scoop the right-hand object.
